propositions: The Git-floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and hard-fails when the file is absent, causing false negatives on every change branched before the floor file was merged.

Gerrit Verified lane sources the workflow definition from main but checks out the patchset tree, creating a mismatch where the gate step exists but its data file does not, regardless of what the change touches.

The established repository convention (documented in _build-and-test.yml ticket ee2a) requires gate steps reading repo artifacts to skip gracefully when the artifact is absent, logging a skip reason; the floor gate violates this by exiting 1 instead.

The gate enforcement for under-floor Git versions (version comparison, diagnostic message with required and installed versions, upgrade path) must be preserved unchanged; only the absent-file case must skip.
Two adjacent gate steps (raw-git-write gate, wall-clock-assert gate) already implement the if-present guard correctly, establishing the pattern the floor gate should follow.
